title: Chart types & timeframes
content:
Available Chart Types
The following is a list of available chart types in TopstepX:
Bars
Candles
Hollow Candles
Line
Line with markers
Step line
Area
HLC area
Baseline
Columns
High-low
Heikin Ashi
Renko
Line break
Kagi
Point & Figure
Available timeframes
The following is a list of available timeframes within TopstepX:
100 ticks
500 ticks
1000 ticks
2000 ticks
5000 ticks
1 second
5 seconds
15 seconds
30 seconds
1 minute
2 minutes
3 minutes
5 minutes
15 minutes
30 minutes
1 hour
4 hours
1 day
1 week
1 month
To change the chart type and timeframe, use the options located in the top-left corner of the chart.
To adjust the timeframe, click on the chart and type the desired interval. Note: Only the timeframes mentioned above are valid.
